snippet.title: The Borderless Official Trailer | Free Demo on Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist The Borderless on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3687370/The_Borderless/

Play the free demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4478920/The_Borderless_Demo/

Build and manage your own floating island in the middle of the ocean...

The Borderless is a cozy floating island management sim where you start with a small platform, expand your island, attract visitors, manage their needs, plan activities, hire staff, and grow your ocean getaway day by day.
